camel_example: aliyun waf-openapi VerifyDomainOwner --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'waf_v2_public_cn-00000' --DomainName 'example.com' --VerifyType dnsCheck --Protocol HTTP
description_en: Verifies that you own the specified domain name. Domain ownership must be verified before you can add a domain name to Web Application Firewall (WAF) by using CNAME access
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi verify-domain-owner --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-00000 --domain-name example.com --verify-type dnsCheck --protocol HTTP --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: VerifyDomainOwner

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to obtain the WAF instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name whose ownership you want to verify
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的域名名称。

您可以设置该参数，模糊查询某个域名是否已接入WAF防护
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The verification method. Valid values:

- **dnsCheck**: DNS verification.

- **fileCheck**: File verification
parameters.help_zh:
校验方式，取值：

- **dnsCheck**：DNS验证。
- **fileCheck**：文件验证
parameters.name: verify_type

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type used for file verification. This parameter is required only when you set VerifyType to fileCheck. Valid values:

- **HTTP**: the HTTP protocol.

- **HTTPS**: the HTTPS protocol
parameters.help_zh:
文件验证时，使用的协议类型，近在VerifyType选择fileCheck时输入。取值：
- **HTTP**：表示HTTP协议。
- **HTTPS**：表示HTTPS协议
parameters.name: protocol
